name: Existential Survival
about: Threats that could kill most people or end civilisation: climate heating, greenhouse gases, nuclear weapons and asteroid impacts.

name: Systemic Health
about: Whether the systems that keep people alive are holding up: peace, wildlife and nature, food, and income.

name: Clean Tech & Access
about: Whether technology's benefits are reaching people: clean electricity, cheaper solar, power at home and internet access. AI investment is shown for context but not scored.

name: Human Flourishing
about: How well people are living: life expectancy, human development, child survival, vaccination and smoke-free cooking.
